claim: *Correspondence strength and governing role are independent.* DocAble's execution machinery consumes an explicit computation model to determine remediation composition. A separate analytical graph view projects that structure and is held in correspondence with its upstream declarations. Stronger correspondence makes the view more trustworthy as a representation; it does not make the view govern execution.

topology.description: One governing model has authority edge to execution and correspondence edge to analytical view; no authority edge from view.

required_terms: Governing computation model Computations · dependencies · composition
Stronger correspondence does not make the view govern execution.
bw_encoding: Black outlines and arrows; white nodes; sparse 3–7% gray groups. Every non-solid relation is locally labeled; no distinction depends on color.
redesign: Native semantic redraw; colors replaced by labeled relations and line conventions.
alt: An authoritative computation model branches into two relations. Authority reaches scheduler execution; correspondence reaches an analytical graph view. Improving the analytical view’s fidelity does not transfer execution authority to that view. The candidate uses black lines, white backgrounds and sparse gray; meaning does not depend on color.
